text:
Anya: quick sync 1: compact chat mock with live stream + token pill attached. want feedback on behavior and microcopy.
Matt: clean visual. q: do we animate the token pill while streaming or only update at stops?
Anya: prefer live increment but subtle (no flashy animation). keeps users informed.
Sophia: accessibility flag: live updates can spam screen readers. only expose final counts via aria-live.
DesignBot: suggest role=status for final count and aria-atomic=true when showing complete totals.
Jess: can we show an estimated regen cost next to regenerate? small helper: "~+45 tokens"
Matt: makes sense but default hide it; enable in prompt library prefs.
Ryan: stop vs pause: product wants compact controls. should primary be Stop and secondary Regenerate, or a toggle?
Anya: Stop should stop and keep partial text. Regenerate should clear and re-run. two actions conceptually, but compact view can surface secondary via overflow.
Sophia: mobile: use a primary icon-only stop button + overflow menu. ensure tooltips accessible via long-press/keyboard.
Jess: copy ideas: Stop tooltip -> "Stop generation. keeps partial reply." Regenerate -> "Regenerate reply (re-run with same prompt)" Token estimate -> "Estimated regen cost"
Matt: microcopy: prefer shorter: "Stop" and "Regenerate" in button labels; keep tooltips single sentence.
Anya: token pill concept: small pill at top-right of bubble showing current/limit e.g., "128/2048". hover shows breakdown input vs output.
DesignBot: breakdown must be keyboard accessible. provide a fallback button that opens detail panel; add aria-expanded states.
Ryan: pinning from prompt library: pinned prompt affects token estimate live. show editable preview on the badge.
Sophia: pinned prompt preview should be inline-editable with an "Edit" affordance opening full editor.
Jess: regenerate for high-cost prompts: confirm modal or just toast?
Matt: propose non-blocking toast for small extra cost, modal confirm for >500 extra tokens. capture telemetry for decisions.
Anya: decision: <=500 tokens show toast; >500 require confirm modal with quick-confirm checkbox.
Ryan: eng event needed: regen_requested with fields: estimate_before, estimate_after, pinned_prompt_id.
Matt: implementation note: debounce UI updates to ~250ms to reduce churn; batch token increments.
Jess: can we animate a tiny nudge when token jumps >100 so users notice? subtle 250ms motion.
DesignBot: recommended spec: update_interval=250ms, aria-live final-only, breakdown accessible via button, contrasts meet 4.5:1.
Anya: next steps: iterate mocks for pill positions (top-right vs inline), generate compact toolbar with overflow menu, and finalize copy options.
Ryan: I'll add telemetry TODOs in the spec.
Jess: I'll post copy variants by EOD.
Matt: I'll prototype debounce + a11y hooks in the playground branch.
Anya: thanks all 10wave10
